dataset: NOAA NCEI CUDEM Hawaiʻi ninth arc-second topobathymetry
license: United States public-domain government data; cite NOAA NCEI

standingWater.method: Regional priority flood with connected-component spill ownership

riverOwnership.method: Bit-packed finest-cell mask; set only when all terrain vertices are above LMSL and all standing-water probes are absent

oceanOwnership.method: Bit-packed finest-cell mask; set only when all exact terrain vertices are at or below LMSL
